content: शलः [शल्-घञ्] .²1 A dart, spear. .²2 A stake. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of शृङ्गि, an attendant of Śiva. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Brahman. .²5 A camel. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a king (शल्य); <ls>Bhāg. 1. 15. 16</ls>, <ls n="Bhāg.">10. 68. 5</ls>. .{@-लम्@} The quill of a porcupine. --({%m.%} also according to some).
